name: Thompson Denver
positioning: Boutique Thompson hotel by Hyatt in Denver's Lower Downtown (LoDo), home to chef Ludo Lefebvre's Chez Maggy
best_for: Travelers who want a walkable downtown Denver base near Union Station and the ballparks
Food lovers interested in chef Ludo Lefebvre's Chez Maggy

facts.text: Thompson Denver is in the historic Lower Downtown (LoDo) neighborhood near the River North Art District.
The hotel is just blocks from Ball Arena and Coors Field.
Denver Union Station is a short three-and-a-half-block walk from the hotel via 16th or 17th streets.
Union Station has direct train service to the airport.
The interiors were created by the design firm Parts + Labor.
Rooms feature woven wool rugs on wide-plank hardwood floors and saddle leather headboards.
Rooms have luxury bedding with Sferra linens and D.S. & Durga bath amenities.
Bar M sits in the hotel lobby at the corner of Market Street and the 16th Street Mall.
Duel Coffee, in the hotel, serves coffee, pastries and morning starters.
Reynard Social Spaces on the sixth floor offers a trio of event spaces with city views.
Chez Maggy Terrace, new in 2025, is an outdoor patio on 16th Street with French bistro chairs and umbrellas.
The hotel is the first Thompson location in Colorado.

highlights.text: Chez Maggy is chef Ludo Lefebvre's first restaurant outside of Los Angeles.
Rooms feature a selection of vinyl records curated by Victrola along with Victrola turntables.
The Thompson Suite is the hotel's largest suite and has a private terrace with seating for eight.
A two-story fireplace is the centerpiece of the lobby.
The hotel welcomes dogs of all sizes at no additional charge, with a maximum of two dogs.

considerations.text: A daily destination fee applies to each room.
The hotel is a cash-free environment.
WhataHotel notes limited on-site parking with downtown premium rates.
